IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION NO. 846/2025
RAVINDRA DILIP PADWAL ...APPLICANT
VS
THE STATE OF MAHARASHTRA ...RESPONDENT
…
None for the Applicant.
Adv. Supirya Kak, APP for the Respondent State.
…
CORAM : RAJESH S. PATIL, J.  
DATED : MARCH 26, 2025
P .C.:
1. When  the  matter  was  called  out,  none  appears  for  the
applicant.
2. The learned APP submits that a copy of the anticipatory
bail application has not been served on the office of the PP .  The APP
also submits that since the papers were not served, she has not able to
contact with the concerned investigating officer.
3. The applicant is directed to serve a copy of the anticipatory
bail application on the office of the PP .
4. Stand over to 9 April 2025.
(RAJESH S. PATIL, J.)
1
Harish
